# Claude Cowork Alternatives

> A decision hub comparing Claude Cowork alternatives — open-source and closed — by licence, where they run, model flexibility, isolation and price.

## Pages
- [Home](https://claudecoworkalternative.com/): what Claude Cowork is and how to replace it.
- [Comparison](https://claudecoworkalternative.com/comparison.html): full table of every alternative with licence and deployment.
- [Self-hosting](https://claudecoworkalternative.com/self-hosting.html): run an alternative on your own machine or infrastructure.
- [Is Claude Cowork open source?](https://claudecoworkalternative.com/is-claude-cowork-open-source.html): licence explainer.
- [FAQ](https://claudecoworkalternative.com/faq.html).

## Notes
- Unlike the open-source-only hub at https://opensourceclaudecowork.com, this site covers closed options too (Cursor, ChatGPT agent, Perplexity Computer) so you can compare the whole field.
- Licences as published upstream; verify before adopting.
